subject: Service stability and renewal: proposed amendment and path to premium
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan@cardotech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@cardotech.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: production latency spikes — urgent

Hi Vivek,

We had a couple of production incidents yesterday where tail latency for generation calls jumped from ~180ms to multiple seconds for 8-12 minute windows. That caused our recommendation engine to fall back to the cached responses and created a visible drop in conversions. We raised a ticket with support, and they confirmed there were repeat spike patterns matching our traffic (attached is our session export).

This is the second time in the last 90 days — we need clarity on what guarantees we can expect going into renewal. Right now the renewal is scheduled for Aug 5 and the team is pushing for an SLA that covers both availability and per-request p95 latency for our production profile.

Can you share what a path to a stronger uptime/latency commitment looks like (and any credit/backstop if those commitments are missed)? We’re prioritizing reliability and want to understand options before locking in the renewal.

Thanks,
Morgan
Senior Engineering Manager
CardoTech

Attachments: cardotech_spike_log_20260714.csv (csv)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@cardotech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: production latency spikes — urgent

Hi Morgan — thanks for flagging and for the log. I’m sorry you hit this again. We take these incidents seriously. I’ve looped in Lauren (CS) and Jonas (Reliability) so we can put a clear remediation and commercial path in front of you.

Proposed immediate steps: 
- Quick triage call today (30 min) to review the attached spike export and our server-side traces
- Short-term mitigation: enable priority routing to a dedicated capacity pool for your critical routes while we investigate (this can be applied in 24–48 hours)
- Commercial path: discuss an SLA amendment to move CardoTech to a Premium availability tier (higher SLOs and faster incident response) with a limited trial period to validate latency behavior before the renewal.

Are you available 3pm PT today or 9am PT tomorrow for the call? I’ll bring a proposed amendment for the Premium tier and a draft credit policy if SLOs aren’t met.

—Vivek
Director, Sales (Renewals)
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@cardotech.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: production latency spikes — urgent

Thanks Morgan — appreciate the export. A quick note from CS on the commercial options so the triage call is actionable: 

Option A — Premium Trial + Amendment
- Immediate: priority routing to a dedicated pool for your production routes (limited to current commit levels)
- 30-day trial of Premium tier (no change to billing for the trial)
- If trial demonstrates stable p95 latency <350ms and availability >99.95%, we’ll execute an amendment to your renewal to lock in Premium pricing and SLOs, effective at renewal date.
- If SLOs are not met during the trial, we’ll revert routing and provide a pro-rated credit for any unplanned downtime per the credit table below.

Option B — SLA Amendment now (short term)
- Execute an amendment before renewal to move to Premium with a 12-month term; this includes a performance credit schedule (see attachment).
- Requires procurement sign-off but provides immediate contractual protection and faster incident response SLAs.

Notes on credits: we can offer up to 20% renewal credit in extreme cases (multiple missed SLOs) but want to avoid retroactive heavy credits — our preference is a trial + measurement approach.

I’ve attached a short latency summary from our side (redwood_latency_summary_20260715.pdf) and a proposed amendment draft for DocuSign. Happy to walk through these on the call.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_latency_summary_20260715.pdf (pdf); proposed_amendment_cardotech_docusign.pdf (pdf)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@cardotech.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Technical notes — observed spike pattern and mitigation plan

Morgan — quick technical summary ahead of the call. I pulled traces for the windows in your CSV and matched them against our infra metrics. High level:
- Root cause hypothesis: transient kernel-level scheduling delays on two hosts in the routing pool combined with a short-lived increase in concurrent requests for a particular sequence length distribution.
- Impact: p95 for affected routes rose to 2.4–3.1s during spikes; overall availability remained >99.7% but not at Premium targets.
- Immediate mitigations taken: drained the two hosts, bumped your routes to a higher-priority queue, and kicked off a capacity replenishment. These actions reduced observed tail latency in our internal tests.

Suggested longer term changes for stability:
- Move critical routes to dedicated capacity pools (faster warmup, less noisy neighbors)
- Enable aggressive prefix KV caching for your recommendation prompts
- Pin a model shard/quantization profile that we validated in our load tests

I’ll be on the triage call. If we proceed with the trial, I recommend a short onboarding runbook so we can measure p95 across your synthetic and production traffic.

—Jonas
Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan@cardotech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, eng@cardotech.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service stability and renewal: proposed amendment and path to premium

Vivek/Team — thanks for the clear options and the triage earlier this week. CardoTech is willing to proceed with Option A (30-day Premium Trial) as long as the trial includes: 
- Dedicated capacity routing enabled within 48 hours of agreement
- A shared measurement dashboard and weekly syncs during the trial
- The amendment prepped in DocuSign so we can sign quickly if the trial validates the SLOs

We’re ok holding the renewal conversation until the trial completes (we’ll keep Aug 5 as a soft target). Please send the DocuSign and confirmation of the routing window.

Morgan
Senior Engineering Manager, CardoTech
